name: tinyworlds
description: Create, edit, and preview browser games in your TinyWorlds account.

interface.longDescription: Describe a game, start its build, check progress, preview screenshots, and modify games in your linked TinyWorlds account. Supports Godot and Bevy browser games. Requires a TinyWorlds account and a running generation backend. New games default to private and a zero paid-asset budget. Builds run asynchronously. Runtime smoke tests do not establish every gameplay rule. Roblox export is not available in this version.
defaultPrompt: Create a small browser game with TinyWorlds.
Show my TinyWorlds games and their build progress.
